mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Expect overcast skies and temperatures near 40 degrees while out by Fireman's Park. The waxing crescent moon is with us, and although the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city is currently processing various election notices and reviewing development plans for the Liberty Business Park. Additionally, residents are reminded that the Municipal Court is available for traffic citations, and you can handle most matters online or via the provided plea sheets if you prefer to avoid an in-person appearance.

It is a busy week in Verona! Yoga at Insight Wellness and the ART House 360 events are both happening today. Looking ahead, Hop Haus Trivia is set for Thursday, followed by live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, and the Dane County Farmers' Market this Saturday.
On October 25, officers found a 40-year-old man passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, resulting in an arrest for an O W I offence.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the delicious Devil's Food Cake flavor of the day. They are currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
